test_defects.detail: The baseline case selected localizedName and description - locale-dependent fields - without supplying cultureName, so the resolver threw ARGUMENT_NULL. Its failure nonetheless surfaced F6 and the reachable trigger for F3.
test_defects.fix: Added cultureName: "{{CULTURE_NAME}}" to the progress query (resolvable token, not the literal en-US the suite's other 88 uses carry). Surgical single-line edit: 1 insertion / 1 deletion, re-parsed and field-compared so that exactly one field changed (MSN-009.Steps) while the 23 other cases sharing that query text were untouched.
test_defects.verification: Re-ran npx tsx scripts/graphql/graphql-runner.ts --case ...:MSN-009 -> PASS 4/4 (errors[] empty against totalCount 29). suites:lint OK, td:validate 075d 173/173.

test_defects.detail: Asserts exactly one new Earned row at amount 300; collides when a sibling mission grants the same amount. Root cause is F5 - BL-LOY-015 is VIOLATED in product, so the ledger exposes no mission identifier and there is no correct field to assert on.
test_defects.disposition: Automation_Status set to Deprecated (EX-201: excluded from execution, runs on no lane). Deprecation is deliberately a human call - TRI-006 keeps it out of tc:demote, which may only reach Manual - and was made by the operator. Retired rather than weakened: an assertion loosened until it cannot fail is worse than one that is red.
test_defects.consequence: The BL-LOY-015 attribution gap loses its only executable witness. It remains recorded as finding F5 and against VCST-5319, and MSNF-080 still asserts the same invariant from the storefront side.
test_defects.verification: Surgical line-level edit; only MSN-019.Automation_Status and .References changed. suites:sync recorded the lane move (075d 29/0/4/1dep -> 28/0/4/2dep), suites:lint OK, td:validate 075d 173/173.

test_defects.detail: BAL_2 read 5226 against an expected 3920; the +1306 is four co-granting missions on order 2. The Redeemed row matched PTS_LINE_TOTAL exactly, so the spend mechanism was independently confirmed correct. Root cause: the case's own Preconditions claimed the spend checkpoint was unaffected by co-grants, which BL-LOY-007(a) contradicts - order 2 is itself a Mixed Cart order and posts its own Earned row.
test_defects.fix: One exact equality and a single-row DOM check were decomposed into three checks against a positional ledger cursor (no mission identifier needed, since BL-LOY-015 is violated and attribution is impossible): BAL_2 = BAL_1 + EARN_2 - RDM_2 (balance reconciles to the ledger), RDM_2 = PTS_LINE_TOTAL (the amount), RDM_2_COUNT = 1 (the count, per BL-LOY-007b/d). BAL_2 and the rows above the cursor are read from ONE render so a grant counted in the balance but not yet rendered cannot manufacture a false failure.
test_defects.rejected_alternative: The orchestrator proposed BAL_2 = BAL_1 - PTS_LINE_TOTAL + sum(earned). The agent rejected it correctly: if currentBalance is the ledger sum, that equation is an identity and would survive a wrong-amount deduction - the same vacuity failure the Step-3 gate caught on MSNF-073.
test_defects.verification: Diff is 13 insertions / 8 deletions confined to MSN-E2E-004 (6 fields); the other 7 rows verified unchanged by newline-normalized field-by-field comparison against git HEAD. suites:review identical to the pre-edit baseline (1 pre-existing Medium on MSN-E2E-002, 1 Informational; zero Blocker/Critical/High). td:validate 083d 134/134. suites:lint OK.
test_defects.strength_gain: The repaired case catches three failure modes the original caught one of: wrong amount (RDM_2 moves), double deduction (RDM_2_COUNT = 2, or the balance reconciliation breaks if debited twice but logged once), and no deduction (RDM_2 = 0).

test_defects.detail: PERSKU-PTS is seeded at $0.00 USD instead of a distinct PTS price, with isAvailable and isBuyable both false, so both modals resolve to USD and the currency-label control is undecidable as seeded.
